# Xenia Way

Xenia Way is a candidate-facing workspace for tracking job applications, employer conversations, follow-ups, and outcomes. Each signed-in candidate has a private application board with six statuses: Saved, Applied, Interview, Offer, Rejected, and Withdrawn.
